articles.summary: Appointment strengthens focus on guest experience, menu innovation and profitable growth Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK) today announced the appointment of Patrick Chung as Executive Vice President of Food Beverage Operations. Chung will lead the Company’s food and beverage operations, with a focus on enhancing the guest experience, strengthening execution and driving profitable growth. “Food and beverage should be a reason guests choose Lucky Strike, not simply something they order once they arrive,” said Thomas Shannon, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Lucky Strike Entertainment. “Patrick brings a compelling combination of hospitality experience, analytical discipline and a passion for understanding what guests want. Our focus is straightforward: deliver food and drinks our guests love, offer great value and execute consistently. Patrick will help us translate that vision into better menus, stronger performance and more reasons for guests to come back.”
articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Appoints Patrick Chung Executive Vice President of Food & Beverage Operations
